definitions.explanation: The earliest form or model from which later versions are developed or derived. Emphasizes the concept of an original design or pattern that serves as a basis for copies or variations.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原型|げんけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1960⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The prototype of this car was made in the 1960s.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原型|げんけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The archetype of modern democracy lies in ancient Greece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原型|げんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In his early works, you can see the prototype of his later masterpieces.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原型|げんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (create a prototype)
- {原型|げんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とどめる (retain the original form)
- {原型|げんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とどめない (be damaged beyond recognition)

USAGE:
Often confused with the homophone ⟦{原形|げんけい}→原形：12078_genkei⟧ (original form/shape). {原型|げんけい} emphasizes the concept of a model or template from which other things are derived, while ⟦{原形|げんけい}→原形：12078_genkei⟧ refers to an object's original physical shape before it was damaged or altered. The expression {原型|げんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とどめない (lit. "not retaining the original form") means something has been damaged or changed so much that it's unrecognizable.
